sampler: all failed drives + healthy drives sampled uniformly without replacement from the (model, disk_id)-sorted list with polars DataFrame.sample(seed)

robustness.stage_holdout: modal power-on-hour stage per drive; held-out stage = test, rest split 80/20 train/cal with default_rng(seed).shuffle (see drives_r2p7)

classifiers.logreg: L2, C=1, lbfgs, 1000 iter, standardised inputs

robustness.prevalence_strata: 5 random drive strata matched to stage prevalences, default_rng(seed)
robustness.training_window_cap: positives kept, negatives sampled with default_rng(seed).choice

held_out_vendor_conformal.weighted_cp: logistic domain classifier, weights clipped to [0.05, 20]
